summary: ONE CANONICAL PRODUCT: repository interplanetarysister/InterplanetaryFund; canonical frontend apps/web (React/JavaScript, Vite). The original Base44 app is a read-only behavioural reference, never a deploy source; Convex, Vercel, and interplanetary-fund-backend are retired. STACK: Cloudflare hosts and runs it — Pages serves the web app, Workers run the API, integrations, webhook intake, AI/agent orchestration, and scheduled jobs, R2 is the sole durable media store (private). Supabase (Postgres + Auth + row-level security) is the sole durable application record store; ownership is enforced server-side by RLS and verified identity, never client-side or by email matching. GitHub is the source of deployable code; merging/auditing/repairing are standing-authorised, but a production build/release always needs the owner's explicit go; GitHub Actions is billing-locked, so releases use the free direct-deploy path. AGENT TEAM: member-facing agents share owner-scoped team context (a conversation with one agent is team context for the member's others, always account-isolated). NEXUS coordinates STORY (campaign writing), ECHO, PULSE, ORBIT, POLARIS, FORGE, LINK, and DISCOVER. REACH is the single front desk for outreach, connections, and growth — one combined chat in front, specialists behind it. NEXUS as chief of staff can put into motion anything any site agent can do and refers members to the right specialist. External campaign publishing/updating always requires explicit human confirmation; deep research (Refine Knowledge about Your Goal) is subscriber-tier, verified server-side. CREATIVE STUDIO: one workspace inside the existing product — story writing, AI image generation/enhancement, captions, AI video generation. A shared trial allowance allows at most 15 AI-generated items across ALL creative tools combined during the 24-hour signup trial (plus earned 24-hour referral extensions), enforced by a fail-closed backend ledger. Generated images are post-checked so model-baked gibberish lettering never reaches member media; caption wording is AI-drafted and passes a deterministic nonsense guard. PAYMENTS — state precisely: PayPal is the priority integration and first APIMatic target. Campaign donations, platform-support payments, and saved payment methods are three distinct systems. CAMPAIGN DONATIONS REMAIN DISABLED until implementation and review complete; Bitcoin remains disabled until implemented and reviewed; the 7% platform fee is taken only at withdrawal, from provider-verified funds, owner-only. Saved payment methods are token-only via the PayPal vault (token, brand, last 4, expiry — never raw card numbers). MOBILE-FIRST, particularly Android; an independent mobile app is expected to share the same backend and data. Full text: executiveagent/docs/IFUND_MASTER_BRIEF.md section (b).
